name: district-zeroing-extension
description: Root scripts only. Each package installs on its own (no npm workspace); see SPEC.md.

scripts.install:all: for d in pipeline packages/bundle packages/engine packages/planner packages/panel-ui apps/extension; do npm install --prefix "$d" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix packages/bundle && npm test --prefix packages/engine && npm test --prefix packages/planner && npm run test:engine --prefix packages/planner && npm test --prefix packages/panel-ui && npm run build --prefix packages/panel-ui && npm test --prefix apps/extension
scripts.test:ny: cd packages/planner && npx tsx scripts/ny-sweep.ts && npx tsx scripts/ny-groups.ts && npx tsx scripts/ny-fallback.ts && cd ../engine && npx tsx scripts/history-check.ts
